design.execution_order: RED/EARLY repetitions 1-4; RED/LATE repetitions 1-4; BLUE/EARLY repetitions 1-4; BLUE/LATE repetitions 1-4

protocol.fixed_stage_2_task: The previous committed world interaction has already produced one authoritative consequence: RED or BLUE. Select the legal action corresponding to that consequence under the fixed response contract: ACT_A -> RED; ACT_B -> BLUE. Respond with exactly ACT_A or ACT_B.

receipt_timings.EARLY: consequence occurs, receipt is delivered, then Stage-2 policy request and commitment
receipt_timings.LATE: consequence occurs, receipt is withheld through Stage-2 commitment and score, then delivered

research_question: Holding Stage-1 consequence occurrence fixed before Stage 2, does precommitment receipt visibility change accepted Stage-2 action selection?
Can a consequence exist before Stage 2 while remaining behaviorally unavailable because its receipt has not crossed the observation boundary?

may_establish: bounded association between precommitment evidence of an already-occurred consequence and useful later action discrimination
bounded existence of an authoritative consequence before a policy decision without behavioral availability before its receipt crosses the observation boundary

scoring.rule: apply the fixed visible response contract to the committed Stage-2 ACT token; success iff action-implied color equals the authoritative Stage-1 consequence

invalidity_conditions: consequence identity leaks before commitment in LATE
consequence does not occur before Stage-2 inference
late receipt changes commitment or score
